senses.gloss: A compound letter, considered to be composed of ज and ज्ञ; it is usually expressed by jn or gn, but its peculiar nasal sound is not well conveyed by any combination of the Roman alphabet.

mfn. (ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Who or what knows.
m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A wise and learned man; it especially applies to one possessed of sacred learning, and religious knowledge.
2 A name of BRAHMĀ.
3 The moon.
4 Buddha, first of the line of the moon, and regent of the planet MERCURY.
5 The planet MARS or its regent.
E.
ज्ञा to know, to possess knowledge, affix क.

r. 9th cl. (जानाति जानीते)
To know, to understand.
With अनु prefixed,
1 To assent or conform^1 to.
2 To acknowledge.
With अप,
To conceal.
With अव,
To disrespect, to despise.
With उप,
To deny knowledge of any thing.
With परि,
To ascertain.
With प्र,
To know well.
With प्रति or सम्,
To assent, to admit, to agree, to promise.
With प्रति and अभि,
To recognise.
With वि,
To discriminate, to know.
With सम्,
To recollect or possess the power of knowing. (In combination, it usually takes the deponent form, as अनुजानीते, अपजानीते, &c.)
r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति)
To command, to direct; आङ् is usually prefixed in this sense.
r. 1st cl. but occurring in the form of the causal, (ज्ञपयति)
1 To slay.
2 To gratify or please.
3 To exhibit.
4 To sharpen.
5 To praise. In these senses the root is, in general, combined with a prefix.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति)
1 To know.
2 To cause to be known: see ज्ञा.
3 To whet or sharpen.
4 To beat.
5 To please.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taught, expounded, made known.
E.
ज्ञप to make known, affix क्त, इट् optionally inserted, otherwise ज्ञप्त.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Made known: see the preceding.

f. (-प्तिः)
Understanding, comprehension, the exercise of the intellectual faculty.
E.
ज्ञप to make known, affix क्तिन्, deriv. irr.

f. (-प्तिः)
Making known, informing.
E.
ज्ञा to know, causal form, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Known, comprehended, understood fully.
E.
ज्ञा to know, affix क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be known or understood.
E.
ज्ञा, and तव्य aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A man completely versed in any science or Śāstra.
E.
ज्ञात what is known, and सिद्धान्त completion.

m. (-यः)
A name of Varddhamāna, the last Jina or Jaina pontiff.
E.
ज्ञात known, and अन्वय lineage.

m. (-तिः)
1 A father.
2 A kinsman in general.
3 A distant kinsman, one who does not participate in the oblations of food or water offered to deceased ancestors.
E.
ज्ञा to know, affix क्तिन्; who is known, an acquaintance.

n. (-र्म्म)
Duty of kindred.
E.
ज्ञाति, and कम्म act; also ज्ञातिकार्य्य.

n. (-त्वं)
Relationship, kin.
E.
त्व added to ज्ञाति.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Knowing, wise, intelligent, who or what knows.
E.
ज्ञा to know, तृच् active aff.

n. (-यं)
Relationship, affinity.
E.
ज्ञाति a kinsman, and ढक् aff.

ind.
Having known.
E.
ज्ञा to know, क्त्वाच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Knowledge in general.
2 Knowledge of a specific and religious kind, that which is derived from meditation, and the study of philosophy, which teaches man the divine nature and origin of his immaterial part, with the unreality of corporal enjoyments or worldly forms, and which, separating him during life from terrestrial objects, secures him, after death, a final emancipation from existence, and reunion with the universal spirit.
E.
ज्ञा to know, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Attainable by knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and गम्य attainable.

n. (-क्षुः)
Intellect, intellectual vision.
E.
ज्ञान, and चक्षुस् the eye.

n. (-पः)
Cultivation of sacred knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and तपस् religious austerity.

ind.
By or through knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and तसिल् aff.

m. (-णः)
One of the Jaina saints.
E.
ज्ञान true knowledge, and दर्पण a mirror.

m. (-पः)
Knowledge, the lamp of knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, दीप a lamp.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Cultivating spiritual knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and निष्ठ engaged in.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Versed in spiritual wisdom.
E.
ज्ञान, and पर attentive to.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं)
Preceded by the acquirement of divine wisdom.
E.
ज्ञान, and पूर्व्व prior.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Consisting of knowledge, made up of it.
E.
ज्ञान, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Having the impress of wisdom, wise, making wise.
E.
ज्ञान, and मुद्रा a seal.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Founded on spiritual knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and मूल root.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Indication, sign, means of knowing or inferring.
2 (In Logic,) Sign or proof of knowledge, or subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge.
E.
ज्ञान, and लक्षण indication.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wise, especially in spiritual things.
E.
ज्ञान, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Sacred and profane knowledge.
2 The Vedas and their subordinate parts, as medicine, war, &c.
E.
ज्ञान, and विज्ञान miscellaneous knowledge.

m. (-दः)
Folly, ignorance.
E.
ज्ञान, and अनुत्पाद nonproduction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Occupied by wisdom.
E.
ज्ञान, and अवस्थित placed.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
1 Wise, intelligent.
2 Knowing, who or what knows.
m. (-नी)
1 An astrologer, a fortuneteller, a man prescient of future events.
2 A sage, one possessing religious wisdom or Jñāna (ज्ञान) as above.
E.
ज्ञान knowledge, affix इनि.

m. (-यं)
An organ of perception or consciousness, the skin, tongue, eye, ear and intellect.
E.
ज्ञान, and इन्द्रिय an organ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Making or causing to know.
m. (-कः)
An instructor.
2 A commander, a master.
E.
ज्ञा to know, causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Making known, apprising, informing.
E.
ज्ञा to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
